title: Street Fighter (2026 film)

text.lead:
Street Fighter is an upcoming action comedy film directed by Kitao Sakurai from a screenplay by T. J. Fixman and Sakurai and a story by Dalan Musson and Gary Dauberman. It is the third live-action feature-length film based on the Street Fighter video game series by Capcom. The ensemble cast includes Noah Centineo, Andrew Koji, Callina Liang, Joe "Roman Reigns" Anoa'i, David Dastmalchian, Cody Rhodes, Eric André, Andrew Schulz, Vidyut Jammwal, Curtis "50 Cent" Jackson, and Jason Momoa. Its plot follows Chun-Li who recruits the fighters Ryu and Ken Masters to join a martial arts tournament and confront M. Bison.
Legendary Entertainment acquired the live-action film and television rights to Street Fighter in April 2023, by which point the film had entered active development, with Capcom co-producing. Danny and Michael Philippou were announced as directors before dropping out in June 2024, with Sakurai joining the following February. Casting took place between May and June 2025. Principal photography began in August 2025 and ended in November.
Street Fighter is scheduled for release in the United States by Paramount Pictures on October 16, 2026.
text.plot: In 1993, estranged fighters Ryu and Ken Masters are recruited by Chun-Li to enter the next World Warrior Tournament. Unbeknownst to them, this tournament will force the two fighters to face each other and their demons.

- Andrew Koji as Ryu
- Callina Liang as Chun-Li
- Joe "Roman Reigns" Anoa'i as Akuma
- David Dastmalchian as M. Bison
- Cody Rhodes as Guile
- Andrew Schulz as Dan Hibiki
- Eric André as Don Sauvage
- Vidyut Jammwal as Dhalsim
- Curtis "50 Cent" Jackson as Balrog
- Jason Momoa as Blanka
- Don Lee as Gouken
- Orville Peck as Vega
- Olivier Richters as Zangief
- Hirooki Goto as E. Honda
- Mel Jarnson as Cammy
- Rayna Vallandingham as Juli
- Alexander Volkanovski as Joe
The character El Fuerte will also appear. Kyle Mooney appears in a minor role as Martin. Streamers Maximilian Dood, LazarBeam, Lachlan, and Bubbell, former professional fighting game players Justin Wong and IFC Yipes, and internet personality Nathan Lust all cameo as Bison's inmates.
text.production:
Development:
In April 2023, Legendary Entertainment purchased the live-action film and television rights to the Street Fighter video game series by Capcom. It would be the third live-action adaptation following Street Fighter (1994) by Universal Pictures and Street Fighter: The Legend of Chun-Li (2009) by 20th Century Fox. The brothers Danny and Michael Philippou were in talks to direct. In June 2024, they dropped out to direct Bring Her Back (2025). In February 2025, Kitao Sakurai was hired to direct.
Casting:
Noah Centineo, Andrew Koji, Jason Momoa, Roman Reigns, Orville Peck and Callina Liang were cast in June 2025. Shortly thereafter, 50 Cent confirmed that he had been cast as Balrog, and Andrew Schulz joined as Dan Hibiki. In July, David Dastmalchian, Cody Rhodes, Hirooki Goto, and Vidyut Jammwal joined as M. Bison, Guile, E. Honda, and Dhalsim. In September, Eric André, Olivier Richters, Mel Jarnson, Rayna Vallandingham, Alexander Volkanovski and Kyle Mooney were announced to have joined. To prepare for her role as Chun-Li, Liang trained daily in Taekwondo, Muay Thai, and Wushu for approximately two hours, focused heavily on leg strength, and adopted a rigorous bulking diet that included consuming 12 eggs per day and eating every two hours—a regimen she described as leaving her "on the verge of throwing up". By the end of filming, each of her thighs had increased by 6.5 centimeters (2.6 in). In October 2026, it was announced that Don Lee would voice Gouken in flashback sequences.
Filming:
Principal photography began in Australia on August 18, 2025, under the working title Punch, with Ken Seng as the cinematographer. Filming wrapped on November 12.
Post-production:
Leo Birenberg and Zach Robinson composed the film's score, having previously collaborated with director Kitao Sakurai on the Twisted Metal series. The film's visual effects were provided by Digital Domain, DNEG, Framestore, Niche VFX and Od Studios!, with Sandra Balej serving as visual effects supervisor. Titmouse, Inc. will be handling the animated flashback sequences in the film.
text.release:
On February 2, 2026, Legendary appointed Hasbro as the global master toy licensee for the film. A graphic novel anthology would be published by Legendary Comics featuring five stories set before the events of the film. One of the stories featuring Bison would be written by David Dastmalchian who portrays him in the film. A crowdfunding campaign was launched on September 9, 2026, on Kickstarter.

Street Fighter is scheduled for release in the US by Paramount Pictures on October 16, 2026, in IMAX. It was scheduled for March 20, 2026, by Sony Pictures Releasing as part of their previous deal with Legendary, but was taken off the schedule less than a year before its release, after Legendary's deal with Sony expired in November 2024. In August 2025, Paramount was in talks to distribute the film after signing a deal with Legendary. In September, they gained distribution rights.
